decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a pronounced, correlated multi-axis step near index 598–602 with persistent offset in N/E/U, and (2) an abrupt, multi-axis trend reversal at the final segment (725–729) where all components change direction sharply. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth variability without clear transient morphology.

regions.observation: Sharp, multi-sample upward jump in N (≈+10 MAD) near index 598–602, accompanied by a simultaneous downward step in E (≈−4 MAD) and a smaller upward step in U (≈+2 MAD); the N and E changes appear persistent over subsequent samples with no clear opposing return within the window.

Broad, multi-segment linear trend reversal in all axes between ~725–729: N declines steadily, E rises sharply after a dip, and U rises steeply—suggesting possible platform shift or superposed motion; the abruptness at the very end (index 725–729) warrants closer inspection despite limited surrounding samples.
